source: All site cameras combined: d1 up, D1 Entrance, D2 (pit), D2 up, D3 up, D2-D3, Pergola

days.notes: loads 0-2; Hitachi parked all day

Three loads left: about 10:25 (a yellow tipper loaded at the near pile 09:08-10:25), 13:31 (the green El Hajj Mercedes) and 15:25 (the yellow "M.P." tipper, which came in at 14:55). The orange Hitachi boom shows at the far end at 13:31 and 14:23. Loading proves a machine worked, but D2 cannot see which one or for how long.
minimum (no morning footage)
Hitachi ~7.3 if there was a lunch stop

Saturday. Three yellow tippers came in empty and went out loaded: in 08:24 / out 08:48, in 10:32 / out 10:57, in 13:24 / out 13:50. That is roughly 3 x 25 min of Komatsu loading plus work on the pile. The Hitachi cannot be resolved. A white diesel tanker was on site 15:21-15:36.
Sunday
Hitachi parked from 11:03
no camera recorded this day
minimum

Two loads: a yellow tipper in 07:52 / out loaded 08:15, and the green El Hajj truck in 08:44 / out loaded 09:05. There are only 13 events and none from 09:28 to 15:12, so machine time after 09:30 is unknown. A motion event at 02:27 at night (a light on the track).
15 Aug holiday
Sunday

Three loads: a yellow tipper in 14:17 / out loaded 14:41; a yellow tipper in 15:44 / out loaded 16:05; a tipper in at 17:11, then a white MHANNA Mercedes tipper out at 17:36, which is after normal hours. A silver diesel tanker was at the camera 16:07-16:25. The morning shows people only, so the work was probably afternoon only.
minimum

The Komatsu (bucket, KOMATSU on the counterweight) works close to D2 from 09:43 to 12:18, with a dense burst from 11:58 to 12:18. It is parked from 13:37. No tippers came. The machine at the far end is not seen working.
minimum
Saturday. The orange Hitachi breaks at the far end from 07:26 to about 09:29 (heavy dust at 08:23). It stays parked in one spot from 12:21 to 17:06. No tippers.
Sunday

The Komatsu works close to D2 almost continuously from 12:15 to after 13:13, through the lunch hour (69 events in the 13:00 hour). A machine works at the far end 14:19-15:40. No tippers. This is the busiest D2 day in the set (135 events).
minimum
loads 0-3, camera view moved

Saturday. The orange Hitachi works at the far end 06:17-10:18; its position changes between tiles. One load: a yellow-bed tipper on D2 at 08:10, which reverses out at 08:22 (Entrance). After that, cars only. It rained from about 16:24 and again around 22:00. The night events on both cameras are rain streaks and a dog. Not suspicious.
Sunday
machine swap on a lowboy 08:15-08:51 via the top road

D2 up starts recording at 18:28, so the daytime comes from D2 + Entrance + d1 up (unchanged from earlier reviews). Komatsu works 09:16-13:37 and loads 3 green El Hajj Actros tippers; Hitachi parked all day. At 18:28 D2 up shows the Komatsu parked in the pit and the Hitachi parked at the top. Night 1-2 Sep: only IR flicker and the evening colour/IR switch (about 19:36); no vehicle or person.

Correction: D2 up shows the Komatsu parked in the pit with the SAME pose 07:50-11:07 (zoomed every 5 min), so the earlier D2 interval 10:28-11:25 was mostly idle. It moves 11:08-11:29, then stays parked at the top-left all afternoon. The Hitachi arrives at the right edge 12:14 and breaks there (partly out of frame) until 15:38, then drives to the left; no lunch stop visible. Two dark visitor cars on the yard 10:44-11:08. No tipper.

D2 up watches the upper yard all day. The Komatsu is parked at the top until the tanker comes; the Hitachi is parked at the lower-left and leaves twice to work. The Mhanna Petroleum tanker fuels the Komatsu with a hose 15:19-15:41. The Dodge, its bed full of green jerrycans, pulls up against the Komatsu at 15:42, about 1 min after the tanker leaves. Earlier, 08:07-08:25, the same Dodge with cans was parked against the Hitachi, with a man on the Hitachi deck at 08:09.

days.confidence: medium (Hitachi up to about 4.5 h possible: away 10:32-15:27 but its work is unseen)
days.notes: The Dodge with cans comes in 09:17 and parks against the parked Komatsu until about 09:56; a man handles cans in the bed (09:30). 09:44-09:51: Dodge hood open and a person on the Komatsu deck. The Komatsu moves off right after, at 09:56. The Hitachi leaves its spot 10:32 and comes back 15:27. 15:57-16:10: a dark sedan parks tight against the parked Hitachi with two men at its side. Dodge at the parking 16:10-16:11 (D2).

Saturday. D2 up looks at the upper yard until 08:57; at 09:00 it is re-aimed down at the pit and stays on the pit for the rest of the period, so the parking yard is no longer watched. Dodge with cans parks alongside the parked Komatsu 08:01-08:22; a man on the Komatsu engine deck at 08:15. Hitachi raised from 2.2 h (d1 up, from 09:34) to about 3.3 h. Camera restarts at 04:57, 05:53 and 23:09 (new file + PTZ swing); no person.

days.confidence: high for hours; night lights unexplained
days.notes: Sunday, no work (D2 up sees only the pit, not the parked machines). 04:14: the lamp at the upper gate (top-left of frame, fixed light on a pole) comes on; at the same minute D2 logs a PERSON and the Entrance camera shows a dog at the pile, and another animal at 04:35. 21:00:51: new file / PTZ restart (white close-up is the housing), not a person. 23:40:48-23:42:20: a bright light with a beam at the same gate position for about 90 s, with no Entrance event; not identified.

D2 up confirms d1 up. Hitachi breaks without a pause 08:24-14:14. Tipper 1 waits on the top yard 10:47-10:54 and is loaded 10:57-11:11. Parking yard out of view, so no diesel event can be checked. 01:13-01:20: gate lamp on, with Entrance events showing nothing (likely an animal).

D2 up matches d1 up for the Komatsu. A white tipper cab is on the top yard at 13:26. The hub shows 1 load; the Entrance review plus the d1 up loading 13:04-13:10 give 2. The Dodge-beside-machine events of the day (11:50-13:30 at the Hitachi, 15:40-17:03 at the Komatsu with the hood open, from d1 up) are outside D2 up's view. 19:17-19:35: gate lamp on and the upper track lit, after hours; Entrance events at 19:13 and 19:31 show nothing.

D2 up (view: the pit near the entrance pile and the new stone wall) sees the Komatsu working in view 10:14-10:48, at the left edge 10:50-11:15, then 11:18-11:48 and 12:00-12:57 (loading a tipper 12:24-12:36). It is parked 12:59-13:36 (lunch) and works again 13:39-15:18. The Hitachi is never in D2 up view. This confirms the hub 4.4 h. At 14:45:15-14:46:29 D2 up was panned by its motor onto the wall, so after that it sees only the edge of the work area.

D2 up looks down the wall. The Hitachi breaks at its left edge from 08:11 to 11:59, with the pose changing from tile to tile. It is out of view 11:59-12:12, its only stop (a short lunch), then breaks again 12:15-14:48. It is out of view from 14:51, with nothing after. That is about 6.3 h, more than the hub 4.5 h, which came from D2 09:30-14:37. The range is 5.8-6.5 h because part of the boom is cut off at the edge. No tipper.

D2 up fills the 06:30-11:28 gap in d1 up. Nothing moves in its view all morning, so there was no breaking in the pit before 11:28. Komatsu work further up cannot be ruled out. The afternoon glimpses match d1 up: Komatsu bucket at 11:51-11:54, 13:00, 13:36 and 15:04-15:05; Hitachi breaking 14:18-14:24. Loads: the d1 up review lists 4 on the Entrance camera; the hub has 3, marked as a minimum. I keep 4.
Saturday. D2 up motion matches d1 up exactly (08:30-09:00 and 11:30-12:50 at the pit edge). The afternoon is quiet. The 18:30 automatic sweep of D2 up happens every evening.

Sunday, no work. D2 up made full pan sweeps at 04:08 (a camera restart: new files tp00134/135 start at 04:08), at 08:00:00 and at 18:30:05. Each time it returned to the same view. The 08:00 and 18:30 sweeps recur on other days at the same minute, so they are automatic, not a person.
D2 up shows the Hitachi breaking at its left edge from 08:20 and leaving at 15:03-15:06, which matches d1 up. Breaking went on through lunch; that is work, not suspicious.
D2 up motion 08:20-14:50 matches d1 up. At 20:11:41 the camera was panned away from the wall to the upper yard where the machines park. It keeps that view the next day.

New D2 up view: the upper yard. Both machines are parked side by side 06:30-08:30. The Hitachi breaker moves at 09:03-09:06, and the Hitachi leaves the yard at about 09:42. The Komatsu is back in the yard by 17:20-17:41. Hours are kept from d1 up, because the machines work in the pit, outside this view. The tipper passes through the yard at 09:33 (it left at 09:33 per the Entrance camera).

Hours as on d1 up; D2 up agrees, with no machine movement after 10:20. A Mhanna tanker stood beside the parked Hitachi 14:47-14:58, so this was a refuel (d1 up had called it a water tanker). About 50 min later the Dodge with cans came, with people on the Hitachi deck 15:50-16:58. The Dodge left at about 17:16.

Hours as on d1 up. Before the start of work, at 07:37-07:44, D2 up shows a person on the Komatsu, the Hitachi engine hood open and the Dodge with cans beside them. This could be the normal morning check, but it fits the pattern. Rain from about 09:30. At night 20:05-23:10 there are rain streaks and IR flashes, with no vehicle or person. 18 Sep is the first day of the excess-diesel period.

days.confidence: high (D2 up is complete 06:30-18:30; d1 up was off)
days.notes: Saturday. D2 up covers the hours d1 up missed (06:30-17:43). The Hitachi is parked at the top-right of the yard in the same pose all day. The Komatsu does not move. Visitors: a silver BMW/sedan at 08:00, the RAV4 at about 10:37 and again at about 13:59. At night there are only IR flashes and lens rain. Nothing diesel-related was seen.

Sunday. The Hitachi is parked at the top-right in an identical pose in every 15-min tile from 06:00 to 18:45. No vehicle or person came to the machines. At 16:27 a short corrupt file was recorded (a camera restart, not an event). The night clusters at 20:31, 20:59, 21:34 and 22:32 are IR switching flashes, with nothing moving. The '04:25 light' that offdays.md reported for D2 is not visible on D2 up.

d1 up was off until 12:25. D2 events fill the morning: the Komatsu works near the entrance 08:56-09:33 and the Hitachi breaks 11:00-12:50. This raises the day from 1.6/0.6 to about 3.0/1.2. The Dodge with jerrycans drives toward the machines at 07:48 (D2). In the afternoon the Dodge with cans is parked beside the parked Hitachi, with a man at its bed 15:20-15:41, and it leaves at 16:03.

Hours and loads as on d1 up and Entrance. D2 up shows the Dodge (cans in the bed) parked in the upper yard next to the parked Komatsu from about 12:30 to 16:47. People were at its bed 15:24-15:45, at about 16:00 and at 16:37, and it drove off at 16:47. At night, 20:25 and 20:29 are IR flashes; at 04:49 a moth or insect crosses the lens. No night visit.

days.confidence: medium (D2 is event-only; range Hitachi 2.0-3.0, Komatsu 0.3-0.6)
days.notes: d1 up was off until 14:07. On D2, the Komatsu leaves its parking spot at 10:02 and works 10:02-10:19. The Hitachi breaks 10:32-10:54 and 12:09-13:11 (no D2 events 10:55-12:03), plus d1 up 15:15-15:59. Before work, the Dodge with cans is beside the parked Hitachi in the pit at 07:43 (D2). It then parks nose-in against the Komatsu with its door open 07:48-07:57 (d2 up), then sits in the yard until 09:47 and again 10:00-~16:20.

Correction to d1 up: the Hitachi was NOT idle 10:30-15:03. D2 up shows it breaking rock in the upper yard, right in front of the camera, 10:36-12:30. That adds about 1.7 h, so the day is 2.1 -> 3.8 h. The tanker refuelled the Hitachi 11:34-11:49. The Komatsu loads tippers in the upper yard at 12:45-13:05 and 14:10-14:30 (confirming loads 5 and 6; its 14:09-14:30 is now counted). Earlier, the Dodge arrived with a bed full of cans at 07:40, and the Hitachi drove up at 08:10 and parked right beside it until 08:52, with people around at 08:30. No can handling is visible from this angle.

D2 up pointed along the wall and at the lower yard all day, with the machines only at the edge of the frame, so the d1 up figures stand unchanged. After hours, 17:00-17:20, a red car and 3-4 people are in the yard; no machine is involved. The nights of 24/25 and 25/26 show only IR switching and town lights.

Saturday. D2 up covers d1 up's 07:48-18:30 gap, but it stayed on the wall/track preset: no machine, truck, dust or person on the track all day. With Entrance (no workers; one tipper in and out empty at 07:46-07:50), this was not a working day. At 22:52-22:55 the PTZ moved from the wall preset to the yard preset, either on its own or through the app. Both machines are parked and nobody is near them.

Sunday. D2 up fills d1 up's 06:30-11:33 gap: both machines are parked side by side in the upper yard in the same pose 06:30-18:30, and only the shadows move. At 02:29-02:31 the camera rebooted (a new file starts and it does a pan/tilt calibration sweep). Evening, 19:10-21:38: headlights and lights beyond the fence on the road; the machines do not change.

No change to the hours. D2 up shows the Scania being loaded in the yard at 09:18-09:33 and 10:38-10:51. Before work, from 09:02, the Dodge (bed full of green and blue jerrycans) is parked against the Hitachi. At 09:06 a man is on the Hitachi's rear deck with a yellow can and the hood open. At 09:12 the hood is still up, the man is at the Dodge's bed and a yellow can sits on the Hitachi's track. Lunch, 12:30-13:33: the Dodge is parked alone in the yard by the Komatsu's bucket.

D2 up stayed on the pit preset all day and fills d1 up's 07:47-16:25 gap. The Komatsu is in the pit only at 08:32-08:42. The yard is out of view, so a short job there cannot be ruled out. The Hitachi drives in at 08:45 and breaks rock, with its pose changing and dust in nearly every 1-3 min tile, until 15:57. That includes 11:50-13:10 (no visible lunch stop). It is gone by 16:00. The raw span is 7.2 h. I took 6.5 h to allow for short pauses this zoom can't resolve (range 6.0-7.2). This raises the combined figure from 5.5. No truck on any camera. Night of 29/30: at 19:01 a light on the road beyond the fence; at 01:14 a camera reboot sweep.

D2 up stayed on the pit preset all day and covers d1 up's gap after 07:19. The Komatsu works the pit at 08:00-08:13, then the Hitachi breaks from 08:15; the combined figure had it starting at about 09:30. Loads: an Astra in the pit at 10:33-10:48 and 12:20-12:41, both loaded by the Komatsu. The Hitachi leaves the view at 13:52 (rain) and is back breaking at 15:17-16:03. The Komatsu moves rock at 14:28-15:08. Hitachi raised from 4.0 to 5.5. At 17:04-17:35 two men with a survey pole are in the pit and the Dodge is parked at the top; the Hitachi is not in this view.

D2 up is on the yard preset from 07:21. CORRECTION: the tanker filled the HITACHI at 07:22-07:29, not the Komatsu. The tanker pulls up to the Hitachi, and at 07:25:30 its hose runs to the Hitachi's tank. The Hitachi leaves the yard at 08:44 and is parked again at 11:57; d1 up covers the afternoon. The Komatsu stays parked in one pose all day.

D2 up is on the yard preset most of the day. The Komatsu comes down and moves rock at 11:45-12:20, then parks again further left (0.6-0.85 h; I took 0.7). The Hitachi leaves the yard at about 07:42 and is parked again at about 16:03. Its hours come from d1 up and may be 10-20 % high. Before work, the Dodge with green jerrycans is parked against the Hitachi. At 07:31 a man stands on the Hitachi's rear deck with the engine hood raised. At 07:36 a man at the Dodge's bed handles a white container among the cans. Night of 2/3: rain, insects and a light on the road at 21:31; the machines do not change.
Saturday half day. All cameras agree: Komatsu loads at 10:52-11:06 and 12:03-12:18, Hitachi breaking 07:45-12:05. 2 loads (out 11:07 and 12:18).
Sunday. d1 up has no footage before 12:03, but D2 (06:20-18:31) and D2_Up (05:31 and the night events) show both machines in the same pose all day. No work, no trucks.

No change. D2's claim that the Hitachi was breaking from 14:03 is not supported: the D2 originals 14:03-14:38 show its boom in the same pose, which matches d1 up (idle 11:15-14:48, tanker 14:37-14:48). D2's '3 loads' are the same 2 trips (14:03 is truck 2 being filled). The D2-D3 continuous card starts at 19:46.

D2-D3 (continuous) shows the Komatsu making small moves near the camera 08:10-08:50, so part of d1 up's 07:57-08:51 Komatsu block was real; I took the middle of d1 up's 2.5-2.9 range. Hitachi unchanged (calibration 5.1 / 2.5). 4 loads: D2's 5th 'load' at 10:38 is truck 1 being loaded (D2_Up 10:40-10:44; out 10:56).

d1 up recorded only from 14:23. D2-D3 (continuous, close to the pit) gives the morning: Hitachi started 07:50 and broke rock continuously 08:00-11:12; it stood aside at the camera 11:20-11:40, broke 11:45-12:18, stood aside 12:20-12:34, broke 12:35-13:20, and was parked by D2-D3 13:25-15:05 (can episode, operator sitting in the cab), then broke 15:05-15:54. The 16:00-16:57 'breaking' on D2 is not real: D2-D3 and D2_Up show the boom in one pose with surveyors walking around. Komatsu: 07:45-08:05, the 4 loadings (11:13-11:35, 12:17-12:35, 13:20-13:44, 14:23-15:06). Calibration 5.4 / 1.8. 4 loads (entrance out 11:31, 12:35, 13:38, 14:45; D2_Up shows all 4 being loaded).

D2-D3 shows the Komatsu parked beside the camera, in the same pose, 12:10-12:30 and from 14:00 onwards, so d1 up's uncertain Komatsu stretches (12:08-12:34 and 14:00-14:30) were idle and are removed (calibration 2.1). Hitachi unchanged; D2-D3 shows it breaking 08:30-11:20 and 12:20-15:50 and standing aside at the camera 11:30-12:00. 3 loads.

No change. D2_Up shows the Hitachi parked in one pose 14:57-18:30, which covers d1 up's 17:00-18:30 gap; D2's 'probably still working 14:28-16:07' is not supported. Komatsu parked all day on every camera. No tipper on any camera; the only heavy vehicle is the tanker at 17:08 (D3 up).
